properties.citation: Salem Chaker, « Amaziɣ (le/un Berbère) », Encyclopédie berbère, IV, 1986, p. 562-568, § 6: Amāheγ/Imūhaγ in the Ahaggar and the Ajjer, Amājeγ/Imājeγen in the Aïr and the south (Niger-Mali), Amāšeγ/Imūšaγ in the Adrar des Ifoghas. Regions: Natural Earth Geography Regions AHAGGAR MTS. and Tassili-n-Ajjer.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the union of the Natural Earth Geography Regions polygons AHAGGAR MTS. and Tassili-n-Ajjer, on Africa's land (Africa's land is the union of the Natural Earth Admin 0 countries whose CONTINENT is Africa), kept as one part with its exterior ring only, so the gap between the two regions is filled; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. Natural Earth draws generalized regions for labelling: the area marks where the form Imuhagh is said, not a limit.
